texto.muro: a wall of stacked grey road cases, their latches and edges running in even rows

escena: SCENE (a night shoot being run, rooftop location in Mexico City, night): he wears the Efeonce team hoodie — its hood, drawstrings and heavy jersey clearly legible, field register on a long cold night. HE IS SEEN IN THREE-QUARTER VIEW from the side of the monitor cart, so his LEFT CHEST IS VISIBLE AND LIT by the screen and the small embroidered emblem on the hoodie reads at its real scale; his chest is not covered by an arm. He sits LOW in the frame at the monitor cart, sharp, one hand on a dial; further back the crew filming are small, soft and out of focus. The eye lands on HIM first and on the crew last. The AZURE-BLUE glow of the monitor is the only light on his face and hands and stays down there; the reserved wall of road cases above him is in even shadow, nothing crossing it. Caught AT THE INSTANT he eases the dial and the waveform settles. 50mm at f/2.

lecho.objeto: the matte black shoulder of a flight case right against the lens, unlit
